title: ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN

anticheat.note: anti-cheat present; Linux/Proton support does not extend to macOS — userspace path works for some titles

provenance: Reported by aj2wavy (highball-db#405, 2026-10-08), Apple M1 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, the environment in DXMT mode, the controller-sdl, corefonts, steam and vcrun2022 recipes, rated 3 of 5 after 14 minutes, offline only. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable offline over a 14-minute session. The reporter could only start it without its anti-cheat, Easy Anti-Cheat, which keeps the game out of online play, and the resolution behaved oddly. It's a Direct3D 12 game, so the page asks for D3DMetal like Elden Ring's. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: The game only starts without its anti-cheat, so online play is unavailable
knownIssues.cause: Easy Anti-Cheat. Its support for Proton on Linux doesn't extend to Wine on a Mac.
